title: Design: Edit Customer with the two tier pickers
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on Default for work orders and Default for Part Sales.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page from Customers.
  2. Click the edit pencil on the customer card.
  3. Open the Work Order Tier picker.
  4. Type tier A's number.
  5. Click tier A.
  6. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 2:

  • Under Work Order Tier a gray help line reads "Prices parts on this customer's new work orders. Existing work orders and Part Sales keep their prices and tier."
  • Under Part Sales Tier it reads "Prices parts on Part Sales. Set on its own: changing the work order tier never changes it."
  • Both fields are outlined pickers with the tier as number · name, between Default Shop Supplies and Notes, as in picture 9.31.

Step 3:

  • A list opens under the field with a "Search tiers" box, then each active tier as number · name, the current one ticked, as in picture 9.33.

Step 4:

  • The search shows the typed number with a clear button, and tier A is listed, as in picture 9.32.

Step 5:

  • Work Order Tier reads tier A's number and name.

Step 6:

  • A white message reads customer A's name with "saved" and "Existing work orders and Part Sales keep their prices and tier."
  • The card's Work Order Tier now reads tier A, as in picture 9.35.
